review.notes: AliStore Courier is a delivery app for electronics retail stores. A store courier sees assigned deliveries and route, records delivery evidence, handles cash-on-delivery and reconciles the completed run. Access is role-based; a store provisions accounts for its own couriers. App Review must receive an active demo courier account with representative non-production review data.
review.appReviewNotes:
Paste this text into App Store Connect > App Review Information > Notes.

WHAT THE APP IS
AliStore Courier is the delivery application of AliStore, a retail operations platform for electronics stores. A courier working for a subscribing store sees the deliveries assigned to them and the route for the day, records the outcome of each handover, handles cash-on-delivery amounts and reconciles the finished run with the store. Access is role-based and each store provisions accounts for its own couriers, so a courier account is required to use the app.

DEMO ACCOUNT
Accounts are provisioned by each store from its ERP back office, so the app has no self-service registration by design. We created a dedicated review courier account for this submission and filled it into the Demo Account fields above.
The app opens on a sign-in screen with two fields, labelled in Russian: the first is the user name, the second is the matching sign-in credential. Enter exactly the two values from the Demo Account fields and tap the sign-in button. There is no one-time code step, no SMS, and nothing you need to request from us. Two-factor authentication is switched off on this account.
The account is loaded with representative non-production review data (a sample route with deliveries and cash-on-delivery amounts), so nothing you do in review affects a live store. If the account ever stops working during review, message us and we will re-issue it immediately.

WHAT TO EXPECT
Location is used only to show the assigned route while the app is in use; the app does not track users across apps or websites and ships a privacy manifest declaring NSPrivacyTracking=false. Delivery evidence photos stay in the store system and are attached to the order. Cash-on-delivery reconciliation is recorded in an append-only audit ledger scoped to the review store. Push notifications carry delivery assignments only.

CONTACT
Support: https://ali.kg/support. We monitor App Review messages continuously during review.

ru-KG.promotionalText: Маршруты, подтверждение доставки и сверка наложенных платежей для доставки розничного магазина.
ru-KG.description: AliStore Courier — приложение доставки для розничных магазинов электроники. Курьер магазина видит назначенные доставки и маршрут, фиксирует результат вручения заказа, ведёт операции с наложенными платежами и сверяет завершённый рейс. Доступ ролевой: магазин выдаёт учётные записи своим курьерам.
